QuestInfo.name: A Fact Finding Mission
QuestInfo.0: The little mountain village was shabby, and not much to look at. It's residents managed a meager living providing lumber, fur and leather to the nearby settlement of El Nath. But when night falls, terror strikes. What kind of #bmonster#k could leave such hardy folk shaking in their snow boots?
